basic_details.job_title: AYCL Asst. Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Andrew Yule & Company Limited (AYCL), a Government of India Enterprise, is filling one post of Asst. Manager (Business Development) E2 on permanent roll in its Electrical Operations (Chennai), on the pay scale E2 - 50000-160000. The essential qualification is a degree in Electrical or Electrical's allied field/stream with minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in Business Development. Online applications open on 13 November 2026 and the last date is 03 December 2026, at www.andrewyule.com.

how_to_apply: Go to the Company's website www.andrewyule.com and open career opportunity.
Select online submission of application, then Advt. No. 2026/14/01, then Apply Now.

Have a PAN/Aadhaar card, an active email ID and a mobile phone number ready. The email ID and mobile number must remain valid for at least a twelve-month period for future communication, including issue of call letters.
Keep a scanned copy of the latest passport size photograph in JPG/JPEG format, not exceeding 1 MB, ready for uploading before applying.
Apply on or before 03 December 2026. No other mode of submission of application is allowed.
Queries may be sent to [email protected]. AYCL is not responsible if candidates fill in their details wrongly and the application is rejected as a result.
PAN/Aadhaar card, active email ID and mobile phone number (needed before applying)
Scanned latest passport size photograph, JPG/JPEG, not exceeding 1 MB
Original documents in support of qualification, experience and age, to be produced at the time of interview

No Objection Certificate, for candidates working with Govt. Departments, statutory corporations or Public Sector Enterprises; it may be produced before the interview if not enclosed with the application

rows.details: Andrew Yule & Company Limited (A Government of India Enterprise)

content_sections.heading: About Andrew Yule & Company Limited
content_sections.text: Andrew Yule & Company Limited (AYCL), with its office at 8, Dr.Rajendra Prasad Sarani, Kolkata-700 001, manufactures, sells and services industrial products such as transformers and industrial fans. It also has fifteen tea gardens under its control. AYCL became a Government of India Enterprise in 1979 and has three Operating Divisions (Engineering, Electrical and Tea) and one service Division, the General Division.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience: minimum 3 years Post Qualification Experience in Business Development in transformer/power industry or capital goods related to Electrical/power industry. Age relaxation and reservation: reservation for SC/ST/OBC/minority/differently abled persons/EWS applies as per guidelines of the Union Government, and age relaxation will be as per Government norms for these categories. The notice also says age relaxation may be considered for deserving candidates, and that experience and age relaxation and a higher initial Basic may be considered for deserving candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Degree in Electrical or Electrical's allied field/stream
rows.desirable: Preference shall be given to people with additional management qualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is on Permanent roll, with Grade E2 and scale of pay 50000-160000. Apart from Basic Pay, the post carries Dearness Allowance (IDA pattern), Medical reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession, Leave, and Conveyance and food allowance/lunch in accordance with the policy of the Company. Encashment of Privilege Leave is included, and coverage under contributory Provident Fund and Gratuity as per rule is also applicable. The notice says that circumstances warranting, incumbents may be selected at a grade one step below. Selected candidates may be transferred and placed anywhere in India, and transfer is a service condition.

content_sections.heading: AYCL Asst. Manager (Business Development) E2 Job Description
content_sections.text: Ensure sufficient order booking for Power Transformers. Work closely with sales, tendering, and engineering teams to shape winning strategies. Identify and develop new business / markets / client. Evaluate and enter new segments (e.g., Industries, real estate, renewables etc.) for expanding the transformer business. Generate and validate leads through networking, exhibitions, and digital channels and conversion to order. Track upcoming tenders, EPC projects, utility investments, and private sector developments. Monitor market trends, policy changes, and competitor activities. Provide inputs for pricing, positioning, and product customization.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AYCL Asst. Manager (Business Development) E2
content_sections.text: Go to the Company's website www.andrewyule.com and open career opportunity. Select online submission of application, then Advt. No. 2026/14/01, then Apply Now. Have a PAN/Aadhaar card, an active email ID and a mobile phone number ready. The email ID and mobile number must remain valid for at least a twelve-month period for future communication, including issue of call letters. Keep a scanned copy of the latest passport size photograph in JPG/JPEG format, not exceeding 1 MB, ready for uploading before applying. Apply on or before 03 December 2026. No other mode of submission of application is allowed. Queries may be sent to [email protected] . AYCL is not responsible if candidates fill in their details wrongly and the application is rejected as a result. PAN/Aadhaar card, active email ID and mobile phone number (needed before applying) Scanned latest passport size photograph, JPG/JPEG, not exceeding 1 MB Original documents in support of qualification, experience and age, to be produced at the time of interview No Objection Certificate, for candidates working with Govt. Departments, statutory corporations or Public Sector Enterprises; it may be produced before the interview if not enclosed with the application

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be through interview or any other method as decided by the Management. The Company reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the interview on parameters decided by the Company, and no clarification on this will be entertained at any stage. Submitting an application or meeting the eligibility criteria gives no right to selection, shortlisting, interview or employment. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. Candidates will not be provided TA/DA for attending the interview. A panel may be drawn from this recruitment process and used to fill vacancies arising later if needed.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AYCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Asst. Manager (Business Development) E2 in Electrical Operations (Chennai). The notice says the number of vacancies is indicative and may be increased or decreased on need basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AYCL Asst. Manager post?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of online applications is 03 December 2026. The online application opens on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AYCL Asst. Manager (Business Development) E2?
faq.answer: A degree in Electrical or Electrical's allied field/stream, with minimum 3 years Post Qualification Experience in Business Development in transformer/power industry or capital goods related to Electrical/power industry. Preference goes to people with additional management qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AYCL Asst. Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 37 years, counted from the date of publishing of the advertisement. Age relaxation is as per Government norms for the said categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the AYCL Asst. Manager (Business Development) E2 post?
faq.answer: The scale of pay is E2 - 50000-160000. Dearness Allowance (IDA pattern), Medical reimbursement, Leave Travel Concession, Conveyance and food allowance/lunch, and other benefits apply as per Company policy.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AYCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at www.andrewyule.com through career opportunity, online submission of application, Advt. No. 2026/14/01, Apply Now. No other mode of application is allowed.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AYCL Asst. Manager (Business Development) E2?
faq.answer: Selection will be through interview or any other method decided by the Management. The Company may shortlist candidates for interview on parameters it decides.

faq.question: Q8. Is the AYCL Asst. Manager job permanent?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications for the post on Permanent roll in Electrical Operations (Chennai). Selected candidates may be transferred and placed anywhere in India, as transfer is a service condition.

faq.question: Q9. Will AYCL pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates will not be provided TA/DA for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post in this AYCL advertisement?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for only one position against the advertisement, and multiple applications from the same person against a post are liable to be rejected.
